verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page has a single claim that users can "Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks." Webhook-triggered workflows suggest event-driven automation, but nothing documents how rules are defined, which events exist, or what actions can be triggered. Schedules are time-based recurrence rather than event triggers, so they don't count toward this story, and per-tool access control is a different feature. Missing for 10: documentation of rule or trigger definition, a catalog of supported events and actions, workflow configuration details, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
